title: Manhole Cover Gol Kyun Hota Hai? 🕳️

shots.vo: मैनहोल के ढक्कन गोल होते हैं, और इसके पीछे एक समझदार वजह है।
shots.prompt: a round cast iron manhole cover on a wet city street at night, reflections, close-up, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Manhole ke dhakkan gol hote hain, aur iske peeche ek samajhdaar wajah hai.

shots.vo: चौकोर ढक्कन में एक दिक्कत है। उसे तिरछा करो, तो वो अपने ही होल में से सरक कर गिर सकता है।
shots.prompt: a square metal hatch tilted and falling into a dark square hole, dramatic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Chaukor dhakkan mein ek dikkat hai. Use tirchha karo, to wo apne hi hole mein se sarak kar gir sakta hai.

shots.vo: क्योंकि चौकोर की कोनों के बीच की दूरी, उसकी साइड्स के बीच की दूरी से ज़्यादा होती है।
shots.prompt: a square metal plate on concrete with light catching its corner, top-down, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Kyunki chaukor ke kono ke beech ki doori, uski sides ke beech ki doori se zyada hoti hai.

shots.vo: गोले की चौड़ाई हर दिशा में बराबर होती है। उसे कैसे भी घुमाओ, वो कभी अंदर नहीं गिर सकता।
shots.prompt: a worker lifting a round manhole cover on its edge above the hole, street level, cinematic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Gole ki chaudai har disha mein barabar hoti hai. Use kaise bhi ghumao, wo kabhi andar nahi gir sakta.

shots.vo: और ये ढक्कन भारी होते हैं। अक्सर सौ पाउंड से ज़्यादा के कास्ट आयरन के।
shots.prompt: a heavy cast iron manhole cover being lifted with a hook, sparks of effort, gritty, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Aur ye dhakkan bhaari hote hain. Aksar sau pound se zyada ke cast iron ke.

shots.vo: अगर एक भी सीवर में गिरे, तो नीचे काम कर रहे वर्कर को चोट लग सकती है।
shots.prompt: a sewer worker in a hard hat climbing down a ladder into a manhole, looking up, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Agar ek bhi sewer mein gire, to neeche kaam kar rahe worker ko chot lag sakti hai.

shots.vo: गोल ढक्कन को लुढ़काना भी आसान है, और वापस लगाते वक़्त उसे सीध में लाने की ज़रूरत नहीं पड़ती।
shots.prompt: a worker rolling a round manhole cover on its edge across the street, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Gol dhakkan ko ludhkana bhi aasaan hai, aur wapas lagate waqt use seedh mein laane ki zaroorat nahi padti.

shots.prompt: top-down view of a round manhole cover with rain puddles around it, moody, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Seedha sa aakaar. Gambhir wajah.
